text:
omar (Eng Manager): Quick question - we're promoting an internal IC L1 -> L2 to start on new team next month. Want promo effective day 1 and small one-time sign-on. What do we need to submit?

zoe (People Ops): Congrats! For internal promos effective on start date: manager justification, comp target, any equity ask, and effective date. Upload to the leveling portal.

omar (Eng Manager): Do we need Finance sign-off for a $2k one-time sign-on?

leah (Compensation): For one-time cash <= $5k, comp approves and payroll processes; Finance only if > $5k or if budget code missing. Provide budget owner and cost center.

omar (Eng Manager): If effective date is >30 days retro, is backpay required?

leah (Compensation): Yes: >30 days retro needs backpay approval. Submit backpay request with old/new salary, effective date, and months retro. We route to Finance after comp sign-off.

payroll-bot: Reminder: do not post SSNs or bank details here. Use https://redwood/payroll/secure for any PII.

omar (Eng Manager): Template for manager justification?

zoe (People Ops): Keep it short: 3 bullets: scope & impact, new responsibilities, calibration evidence. <150 words preferred.

mike (Payroll): When you submit payroll ticket include employee ID (in secure form), whether sign-on is lump-sum or recurring, and tax withholding preference. Lump-sum typically withheld at supplemental rate unless they elect different handling.

omar (Eng Manager): Uploaded justification and comp target to portal and flagged "promo + sign-on".

zoe (People Ops): Got it. Leah will review comp, then if backpay needed we'll route to Finance. I'll close when Payroll confirms execution after start date. Thanks! :thumbsup:
